Name: Nyapu Styled Ferngill Fashion Festival portraits
Author: TastyHarakomeshi
Description:
This MOD replaces the original costume portraits created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453]AirynS[/url] for the Ferngill Fashion Festival with portraits in Nyapu's art style.

Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/95265773]skellady[/url], the creator of the Ferngill Fashion Festival, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453]AirynS[/url], the creator of the Portraits, for granting permission to use their work!
Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for creating the original Portrait art style!


Original Authors :  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url]  (OG Portraits),   [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453]AirynS[/url]  (OG Mod Portraits).
